__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A hierogylph-engraved mace has been left here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The mace is formed from solid brass, and engraved in strange hieroglyphs.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: egyptian mace

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Sand-colored robes lie here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The robes are colored a sandy off-white, and are in fact caked and covered
with sand as well.  You don't seem to be able to remove all of the sand, no
matter how much you try.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sand robes

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A flat dirk made of chipped obsidian lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The blade of the dirk is black, glassy obsidian, chipped razor sharp.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: obsidian dirk

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A dirty cloth turban has been forgotten here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The turban used to be white cloth, now it is covered with oil and dirt from
the head and hair of its previous owner, who must not have bathed much.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: cloth turban

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Long cloth wrappings lie on the ground in a pile.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The cloth wrappings are old, wrinkled, and stink of embalming fluid.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: cloth wrappings

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A dusty bottle lies here on the ground.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The bottle is dusty and the fluid has a strange sickly-sweet smell to it.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: bottle fluid

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small jar lies here on the ground.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The jar is sticky and smells really bad.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: jar formaldehyde

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A little ball of fire hovers in the air before your eyes.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The ball of fire is hot to the touch and very very bright.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: ball fire
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: a small hot ball of fire

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A curved scimitar made of stone rests on the ground.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The scimitar is formed from solid stone, chipped and carved to perfection,
with a sharp, cold blade that is marred only by a few nicks here and there.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: stone scimitar

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A stone key has been dropped here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The key is made from stone, but is otherwise unremarkable.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: stone key

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A mighty stone sarcophagus lies in the center of the tomb.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The sarcophagus is engraved on the sides with the images of pharoahs,
great wars fought long ago, mighty pyramids being constructed...

A raised image atop the sarcophagus is formed in the visage of one of
the mighty pharoahs, painted in gold and studded with precious gems.

You see a small keyhole in the side of the sarcophagus.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: stone sarcophagus

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small pile of dust is being scattered by the breeze.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The dust is old.  As you sift it through your hands you find tiny chips
of aged bone inside -- it must be the ancient remains of something.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: dust

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small emerald scarab lies here on the ground.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The scarab is intricately detailed, down to the tiny hairs on its
insectile legs and the faceting of the emeralds in its eyes.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: scarab

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small, tarnished, battered lamp has been dropped here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The lamp is quite old and tarnished.  You rub at it to get some of the
grime off, but it doesn't seem like anybody is home.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: lamp

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small brass ankh has been left here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The ankh is a small brass symbol of an ancient religion.
It glows with a soft bright light that is soothing to you.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: ankh

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A medium-sized parchment book with well-worn pages lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The book has well-worn pages, containing many befuddling riddles
to surprise, confuse, and amuse you.  You find yourself bewildered
by its contents and put it down to sort your head out.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: book riddles

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: The mighty paw of a lion-like creature has been dropped here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The massive paw has straps on it formed of bronze, so that it will
fit snugly over your hand.  As you put it on, it melds with your hand,
becoming an extension of your arm.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: lion paw

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small piece of parchment covered in hieroglyphics lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
You cannot decipher the strange hieroglyphics that cover the
sheet of parchment.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: answer

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: The massive treasure of the sphinx lies here in a big pile.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The treasure is incredibly large, filled with gold coins and valuables, more
wealth than you could ever possibly imagine accumulated in one place.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: treasure

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: You see a small pile of sand.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You think you see some coins and valuables glinting amongst the grains of sand.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: pile sand

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Some fortunate soul has escaped the mummy's curse, for now.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
Rumor has it that whomever disturbs the grave of the mummy shall be
cursed for all eternity, and that the descendents of that person shall
likewise be cursed for ten generations to follow.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: curse mummy

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small glass elixir lies under your feet.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The elixir is deceptively small.  Something tells you that its
contents are truly quite potent.  Perhaps too potent for ordinary
mortals to attempt to consume.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: small elixir

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A beautiful, intricately detailed mask has been forgotten here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This beautiful mask was shaped from solid gold and magically enchanted
to perfectly fit the face of any who choose to wear it, its golden features
and turquoise highlights even moving to match the expressions of the face
of the wearer.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: golden mask

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
Aha!

You see a multifaceted gemstone, which strangely reflects no
light, making it very hard to see when it lies on the ground.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small length of brass shines here with its own light.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This small brass shaft is a holy weapon used by the ancient people of
this land to defend against the deadliest of foes.  It shines with the
brilliant blazing light of the sun.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sun wand

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small sandy-colored ring has been carelessly dropped here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The ring is small, smooth, sandy-colored and unremarkable, save that
it gives off a continuous low humming noise that tickles your fingertips.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sandy ring

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small golden sphinx glints in the light.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The golden sphinx is incredibly detailed and very small, fitting easily
into the palm of your hand.  You can even make out the expression
of wisdom and peace on its face.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: golden sphinx

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Massive leggings formed from the body of a sphinx stand here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
These magically fashioned leggings impart the strength and stamina
of the mightiest of the ancient sphinxes.  You feel ancient power
emanating from them; they seem to be almost alive.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: spinhxian leggings
